    StartersCafe 80's friesSpiral curly fries with smoked paprika saltHow to make it4 large potatoes2 L vegetable oil1 tsp fine salt1 tsp smoked paprikaSpiralise the potatoes and soak in cold water so the starch rinses out.Drain and dry very well on clean tea towels, any water will spit in the oil.Heat the oil to 180°C and fry in batches until crisp and golden.Mix the salt with the smoked paprika, toss through the hot fries and serve straight away.Hoverboard tortilla chipsPink hoverboard tortilla chips with guacamoleHow to make it6 flour tortillas1 L vegetable oil1 tsp beetroot powder3 avocados1 limesalt, to tasteCut the tortillas into hoverboard shapes with a knife or template.Heat the oil to 180°C and fry the shapes in batches until crisp, then drain on paper towel.Toss the hot chips with salt and the beetroot powder until pink.Mash the avocados with the lime juice and salt to make the guacamole. Serve with the chips.Sports almanac parmesan crackersFifty years of results in one bookHow to make itAs written, serves 4Crisp parmesan and rosemary crackers rolled thin and cut into little book shapes, baked golden and served with a fig and onion jam.Rub 60g cold butter into 120g plain flour, then mix in 80g finely grated parmesan, 1 tsp chopped rosemary and a pinch of salt.Add 2 to 3 tbsp cold water to bring it together and chill 20 minutes.Roll 3mm thick and cut into 4 by 6cm rectangles.Score a line down the middle of each like a book spine.Bake at 180°C for 12 minutes until golden.Serve with fig jam.Crispy chicken tenders with honey mustardOrdered from the Ronald Reagan video screen.How to make itA house standard, not part of tonight's cook.MainsHydrated pizzaThin New York pepperoni pizza after a quick mini pizza revealHow to make it4 mini pizza bases500g pizza dough200g crushed tomatoes300g low-moisture mozzarella100g pepperoniHeat the oven to its highest setting with a pizza steel or heavy tray inside.Top the mini bases with a little sauce and cheese and bake for the reveal.Stretch the dough as thin as you can and spread with the crushed tomatoes.Scatter over the mozzarella and pepperoni.Bake on the hot steel at maximum heat until the crust blisters and the cheese bubbles.Biff's Paradise steak and lobster macCasino excess in the bad 1985How to make itAs written, serves 4Rib eye seared and butter-basted with peppercorn sauce, beside a gooey cheddar macaroni with butter-poached lobster folded through.Salt 4 rib eye steaks the night before.Cook 300g macaroni.Melt 40g butter, stir in 40g flour, whisk in 600ml milk and cook until thick, then add 200g cheddar and the pasta.Poach 2 raw lobster tails, cut into chunks, in 60g butter for 4 minutes and fold through.Sear the steaks 3 minutes a side, basting with butter, and rest 8 minutes.Add 2 tbsp brandy, 1 tbsp cracked pepper and 150ml cream to the pan and reduce.SweetsJaws 19 shark jellyBlue
